question_evidence_quote: Each day Marc watches 1/10 of the episodes he bought.
observed_error: The response substitutes 1/10 for the number of episodes watched per day.
violated_condition: Daily episodes watched equal 1/10 × 50; days required equal total episodes divided by daily episodes watched.
error_description: The response divides 50 episodes by 1/10 as though that fraction were an episode count per day. The question states that Marc watches 1/10 of his 50 purchased episodes daily, so the denominator must be 50 × 1/10 episodes per day. The displayed division is evaluated correctly but uses the wrong daily quantity.
